messages:
maya: Heads-up — SOC2 fieldwork slots (Wed-Fri) overlap with KMS HSM smoke tests. We need to swap a slot or shift the smoke run. pinging owners. @elena @owen

owen: Ack. Which slot specifically?

maya: Wed 10:00-12:00 is the blocker. KMS team needs full access for attestation run. Auditors scheduled interviews at 10:30.

elena: I can move the interviews to 13:30 on Wed, but that conflicts with the Dedicated deploy window. :grimacing: 

sam: If we push the deploy to 15:00 we might be ok. Who owns the smoke test? @devops-oncall?

devops-oncall: devops-oncall: We can slide smoke to 14:00 but need 30m prep and 30m cool-down. That would put attestation at 15:00 earliest.

maya: Hmm. Audit team prefers morning. Can we do a slot trade? KMS does smoke on Thu morning and can swap with Wed morning if we free it.

owen: KMS lead (Jin) said Thu AM is tight for them. Proposed middle ground: KMS smoke 09:00-10:00 Wed, auditors 10:30-11:30, deploy 15:00. That gives 1.5h gap for evidence collection.

elena: That sounds workable. I'll confirm with the auditors.

audit-bot: audit-bot: Reminder — evidence collection checklist due 24h before fieldwork. Missing items: keystore rotation logs, staging attestation report.

maya: I'll upload the keystore rotation logs now. @owen can you attach the attestation stub?

owen: Done — uploaded to /shared/compliance/attestations/1767004321/stub.txt

sam: Quick CR ping: I left comments on the KMS orchestration PR (internal/infra#789). Need a +1 to unfreeze deploy.

elena: Reviewing now. small nits only.

maya: Okay summary: action items -> elena confirm auditors (ETA 30m), devops shift smoke to 09:00 Wed, owen attach attestation (done), sam get CR +1, maya push logs. If all green, move deploy to 15:00 Wed.

owen: Noted. I'll stand by for any evidence queries during the window.

elena: Auditors confirmed. They can do 10:30. :thumbsup: 

maya: Nice. I'm updating the fieldwork calendar and the ticket (COMPL-312). I'll also send the new calendar invites.

devops-oncall: devops-oncall: Scheduled smoke 09:00-10:00 Wed, prep 08:30. Noted change of deploy to 15:00. Tagging oncall for the day.

sam: +1 on CR, unfreezing deploy once smoke completes and evidence is uploaded.

maya: Thanks all. If anything else pops up, drop it here. Closing thread after calendar updates.

elena: Cheers.
